title: AGENTIC AI ARCHITECT
description:
**AGENTIC AI ARCHITECT**

**Experience: 12+ Years**

**Employment Type: Contract / Full-Time Employment**

**Location: Pan India**

**Contract Duration: 6 Months**

**Budget: Up to ₹2.5 Lakh per Month**

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Architect to design, develop, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems on AWS. The role involves owning the complete lifecycle of agentic AI solutions, from architecture and system design to hands-on implementation and scaled deployment.

The ideal candidate will combine strong AI architecture expertise with hands-on Python development skills, building intelligent multi-agent systems that address real-world business requirements.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**AGENTIC AI ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN**

Design multi-agent architectures incorporating planning, tool usage, memory, and orchestration for real-world business use cases.

Define agent-to-agent communication patterns, tool calling, function calling, and orchestration strategies.

Design scalable and reliable agentic AI systems suitable for production environments.

**AWS-BASED AI DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT**

Architect and deploy agentic workflows using AWS services, including Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, ECS, and EKS.

Build and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions within AWS environments.

Optimise distributed agent workflows for latency, cost, scalability, and reliability.

**HANDS-ON DEVELOPMENT & IMPLEMENTATION**

Write production-quality Python code to implement agentic AI solutions.

Build core agent components while collaborating closely with Python engineers.

Translate high-level architecture and system designs into functional, production-ready code.

Use orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Bedrock Agents, or custom frameworks.

**RAG PIPELINES & VECTOR DATABASES**

Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and integrate them into agent workflows.

Integrate vector stores such as OpenSearch, Pinecone, and similar technologies.

Design effective retrieval and knowledge integration mechanisms for agentic AI applications.

**GUARDRAILS, EVALUATION & OBSERVABILITY**

Establish guardrails and evaluation frameworks to assess agent performance and reliability.

Implement observability mechanisms for monitoring production agentic AI systems.

Identify and resolve issues affecting system performance, reliability, and output quality.

**PROTOTYPING & PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT**

Rapidly develop prototypes and iterate based on evaluation results.

Take agentic AI solutions from proof of concept to scalable production deployment.

Continuously improve architecture and implementation based on performance evaluations.

Stay updated with emerging agentic AI technologies and incorporate relevant patterns into system architecture.

**KEY DELIVERABLES**

Scalable, production-grade agentic AI architectures deployed on AWS.

Functional multi-agent workflows with effective planning, memory, tool use, and orchestration.

Production-quality Python implementations of core agent components.

Integrated RAG pipelines and vector store solutions.

Reliable evaluation, guardrails, and observability frameworks.

Optimised AI workflows with improved latency, cost efficiency, and reliability.

Successful transition of prototypes into production-ready deployments.

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

12+ years of relevant professional experience.

Strong expertise in AI and Generative AI research and development.

Hands-on experience designing and implementing agentic AI systems.

Strong Python programming skills and experience writing production-quality code.

Experience with AWS AI and cloud services, particularly Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, ECS, and EKS.

Experience with multi-agent architectures, agent orchestration, tool calling, and agent-to-agent communication.

Knowledge of frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Bedrock Agents, or equivalent custom frameworks.

Experience developing RAG pipelines and integrating vector databases such as OpenSearch and Pinecone.

Understanding of AI guardrails, evaluation frameworks, observability, and production monitoring.

Experience optimising distributed systems for latency, cost, scalability, and reliability.

Ability to guide Python engineers while remaining actively involved in implementation.

Strong architectural thinking, problem-solving, and technical leadership capabilities.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

Agentic AI | Artificial Intelligence | Generative AI | AI Research | Multi-Agent Systems | AI Architecture | Python | AWS Bedrock | AWS Lambda | AWS Step Functions | Amazon SageMaker | Amazon ECS | Amazon EKS | LangGraph | CrewAI | Bedrock Agents | Agent Orchestration | Tool Calling | Function Calling | Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) | Vector Databases | OpenSearch | Pinecone | AI Guardrails | Model Evaluation | Observability | Production Deployment | Distributed Workflows | Performance Optimisation

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

Strong AI architecture and system design capabilities.

Hands-on development and implementation expertise.

Ability to design scalable multi-agent systems for production use.

Strong understanding of AWS cloud-native AI deployment.

Analytical thinking and complex problem-solving skills.

Ability to collaborate with and guide engineering teams.

Focus on system reliability, cost optimisation, and continuous improvement.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Opportunity to architect and deliver advanced agentic AI solutions.

Exposure to production-grade AI systems built on AWS.

Opportunity to work on multi-agent architectures, RAG pipelines, and AI orchestration.

A technically challenging role focused on taking AI solutions from proof of concept to scaled deployment.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

Email: khushi@hirednex.com

title: Strategic Builder
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10-15 years of total experience with relevant 5 years into Data & AI in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or program management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and program management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
  
  
fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and build well-architected, cloud-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
  
  
Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
  
  
Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
  
  
Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
  
  
Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS ProServe IN - Karnataka

title: Vice President, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction. Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. **Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data & Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high-quality agent & customer experience.

* Cross-System Integration: Define and govern the strategic approach for integrating different platforms (telephony, CRM, WFM, QA) to ensure data flow, system compatibility, and a unified agent experience.
* Vendor & Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.
* Assesses situations to make appropriate recommendations based on operational needs.
* Adheres to support processes and best practices.
* Prepares and/or reviews functional requirements documentation.
* System Configuration, Development & Change Management: Design, develop, test, and deploy complex system configurations, integrations, and changes based on business requirements.
* Hands-on Coding: Write and maintain ad-hoc scripts, APIs, and microservices (e.g., using Python, Go, or JavaScript) to facilitate system integrations and custom functionality.
* Adapts to prestigeless work within a small team environment.
* Participate in operational meetings for technical guidance and solution proposals.

**Qualification /Personal Characteristics**
**:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Proven experience as a solutions architect or lead engineer, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with Customer Service platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, WFM systems).
* Expertise in designing systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs and RESTful services.
* Programming knowledge (Python, Go, or JavaScript preferred) for ad-hoc scripts and integrations.
* Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to hardware, software, VoIP or network connectivity.
* Strategic Communication & Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical issues and translate system capabilities into business value for both technical and non-technical stakeholders (e.g., leadership, operations teams).
* Analytical & Problem Solving Mindset: Ability to think strategically, solve complex, cross-functional technical problems, and demonstrate strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach.
* Organizational & Team Skills: Prestigeless team player with strong organizational, detailed orientation, and planning skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.

**Benefits**
What’s in it for You?
  
  

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential, free support for personal or work-related challenges—covering counseling, or financial guidance, and more—to help maintain well-being and performance.
* Term Life Insurance: Provides financial peace of mind for your loved ones with a fixed-coverage death benefit over a defined term. Affordable protection offered by your employer.

* Performance-Based Incentives: Earn more when you deliver more. Your hard work pays off—literally.

As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.*

* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues.
* Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency.
* Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using
  **Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis**
  .
* Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling.
* Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads.
* Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services.
* Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Golang**
  , including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling.
* Strong production experience with
  **Apache Kafka**
  , including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics.
* Proven expertise in
  **PostgreSQL performance tuning**
  and database optimization.
* Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs.
* Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability.

Good to Have

* Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems.
* Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization.
* Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana.
* Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases.
* Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

title: DE-NCLC-SPFx O365 Senior-GDSN02
description:

* Must have good experience in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) & Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) solutions.

* Core Skills:

+ SharePoint: SPFx, PnP Framework, PowerShell
+ Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents
+ Dataverse: Data modelling, APIs, integration with Power Platform
+ Web API Integration: REST, SOAP, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
+ PCF Controls: React, Python, TypeScript, PCF control framework

+ Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
+ Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
+ AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
+ Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
+ Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control
+ Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
+ Passion for the web, open source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences.
+ Experience in consulting strongly preferred.
+ Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure.
+ Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers.
+ Interpersonal and communication skills.
+ Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration.
+ Work in collaborative and supportive manner.
+ Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information.
+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* A minimum of 8+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint 2013/2016/2019/o365
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps & Power Automate.
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS & Fluent UI.
* Strong knowledge of PowerShell & PnP.
* Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level:**
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer**
As an AI and Data Solutions Engineer at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
  
  
**The team:**
AI & Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
  
  
AI & Data professionals will work with our clients to:
  
  

* Design and modernize large-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 6-9 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
* Proficiency in cloud architecture design in any of the given areas – AWS/Azure/GCP Architecture.

**AWS Architect**

* Experience in provisioning and spinning up AWS EC2 instances - on-Demand, Spot, dedicated instances, and cost calculation.
* Experience with server less architecture (Lambda), API gateway and RESTful services/JSON etc.
* Experience with one or more relational databases on AWS RDS – Oracle/ SQL Server/ MySQL and/or cloud data warehouse databases such as AWS Redshift
* Exposure to Data migration facilities such as DMS, S3 COPY, streaming, Kinesis, Batch
* Experience in developing applications on AWS Cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to DevOps tools, deployment and orchestration technologies such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline etc.
* Experience with monitoring resources and applications using CloudWatch metrics, alarms and logs and tracking user activity, API usage using CloudTrail
* Experience with cloud assessment and migration on-premise workloads onto AWS.
* Expertise in AWS Architecture, Automation Tools and understanding of the agile development process.
* Experience in Migration from on-prem to Cloud using AWS migration tools
* Experience with VPN connectivity between regions and subnets
* Experience with Business Continuity and Disaster Recover design, planning and implementation for cloud infrastructures
* Exposure to one or more - Python, Perl, Ruby or UNIX shell scripting.
* Experience working with AWS Command line utility (CLI) and SDKs.
* Exposure to EMR, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Athena, WAF, CloudHMS, Direct Connect, Glue, Load balancer
* Expertise in SPARK programming using Scala or Pyspark or Java
* Experience with cloud security architectures – Encryption (Rest & Motion)

**Azure Architect**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and a strong understanding of Azure capabilities and limitations with demonstrated experience in end-to-end deployment of MS Azure BI solution(s)
* Experience in migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.
* Experience in defining highly available, DR solutions in Azure
* Experience in assessing applications for cloud adoption and define Cloud strategy for enterprise
* Experience in using agile methodologies in implementing Azure solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Tools for system management, monitoring, automation, and agile development
* Design and develop robust, scalable solutions for collecting, analyzing large data sets, creating, and maintaining data pipelines, data structures and/or support of highly distributed applications
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure data platform, including Azure Data Factory (ADF),Azure Databricks, Azure Data Flow, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics / erstwhile Azure Data Warehouse (SQLDW), Event Hubs, Stream Analytics, Data Lake Store, Data Lake Analytics, U-SQL, HDInsight, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Purview, Power Apps, Power BI and PowerShell Scripting
* Configure large database solutions in Azure using SQL Server / Azure SQL DWH / Synapse and optimize the existing or new solutions as and when needed for optimum performance.
* Build data lake from multiple data sources with ingestion, data governance and auditing capabilities
* Experience in any of Programming/Scripting languages - Bash, PySpark, Scala, Python, PowerShell, Ruby – would be preferred
* Experience in defining cloud strategy for enterprise for but not limited to migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.

**GCP Architect**

* Experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, and technical consulting with expertise in architecting and rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
* Experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning and experience with data analytics and data visualization techniques and software.
* Experience in GCP Dataflow, BigQuery, Dataproc, Datalab, Dataprep, Pub/Sub and Genomics
* Experience with core Data Science techniques such as regression, classification or clustering, and experience with deep learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, Torch, Caffe, Theano, etc).

* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements and environments (such as Apache Beam, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Flume).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem

* Knowledge of cloud computing includes virtualization, hosted services, multi-tenant cloud infrastructures, storage systems and content delivery networks.

description:

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled
**AI/ML Expert**
to lead and innovate in the development of advanced machine learning solutions, with a focus on large language models (LLMs) and generative AI tools. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in designing, deploying, and optimizing AI models, leveraging cutting-edge frameworks and infrastructure. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable AI applications, enhance existing models, and explore new AI-driven solutions to meet business objectives.

AI Frameworks: Deep experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

title: Leadership - System Engineering
description:
We are looking for an experienced systems engineering leader to head our Systems Engineering function for UAV/UAS platform development. In this senior leadership role, you will build and lead a high-performing team of systems engineers, owning end-to-end system architecture, requirements management, and verification & validation across our unmanned aerial platforms — including hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing systems. You will be the technical authority bridging mechanical, electrical, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload sub-disciplines, ensuring the platform is engineered as a coherent, certifiable, and mission-ready system, while partnering closely with program management, manufacturing, quality, and customers to deliver robust, field-proven products.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Establish, lead, and continuously mature the Systems Engineering function — defining processes, tools, and governance for requirements management, system architecture, interface control, and verification & validation (V&V) across the UAV product portfolio.2
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of systems engineers across requirements, architecture, integration, and test disciplines, fostering technical depth, accountability, and career growth.
* Own system-level architecture and trade studies for hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing UAV platforms — balancing payload, endurance, propulsion, structural, and mission performance requirements.
* Drive requirements engineering and traceability from customer/stakeholder needs (GSQR/SRS) through system, subsystem, and component-level specifications, ensuring full bidirectional traceability.
* Lead integration and verification & validation planning across propulsion, avionics, GNC/flight controls, EMI/EMC, structures, and payload subsystems, ensuring compliance to applicable standards (MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, ARP4754A, STANAG, DO-160 where applicable).
* Own technical risk management at the system level — identifying, assessing, and tracking design and integration risks, and driving mitigation through design reviews and test campaigns.
* Chair and govern technical design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) and serve as the senior technical interface with program management, quality, certification bodies (CEMILAC/DGQA), and customers.
* Partner with PMO, manufacturing, supply chain, and procurement to ensure system designs are manufacturable, testable, and aligned with program schedules and cost targets.
* Drive root-cause analysis and design improvements from flight test, field deployment, and reliability/endurance data, closing the loop into the engineering baseline.
* Lead make-vs-buy and vendor technical evaluations for critical subsystems (propulsion, avionics, payload, navigation) and manage technical relationships with external partners and consultants.
* Drive systems engineering tooling and infrastructure investments (requirements management, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), configuration management, simulation platforms).

You will help India's leading financial institutions leverage AWS to modernize their technology landscape, build innovative digital products, drive cloud-native transformation, and adopt AI/ML and Generative AI to unlock new business value.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you will own the technical engagement and success of specific customer projects, develop deep expertise in AWS technologies, and understand how applications and services are constructed on the AWS platform. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to CTOs, CIOs, and engineering leaders at India's most prominent financial services organizations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own the technical relationship with assigned FSI customers, acting as their trusted cloud advisor and driving architectural best practices across their AWS journey.
  
  
Design and architect scalable, secure, and cost-optimized cloud solutions for banking core modernization, payments infrastructure, insurance platforms, and capital markets workloads.
  
  
Conduct Well-Architected Reviews and provide actionable recommendations across reliability, security, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and operational excellence pillars.
  
  
Build and deliver Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and technical demonstrations to validate architectural approaches, accelerate customer decision-making, and remove technical blockers.
  
  
Guide customers on adopting Generative AI and AI/ML services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Comprehend) for use cases such as document processing, fraud detection, customer engagement, and risk analytics.
  
  
Partner with AWS Specialist teams (Analytics, Security, Migration, Containers, Serverless) to implement end-to-end solutions addressing complex multi-domain requirements.
  
  
Advise on cloud migration and modernization strategies including re-platforming legacy on-premises workloads, containerization, serverless adoption, and data platform modernization.
  
  
Present architecture patterns, best practices, and case studies to customer technical communities, C-Suite executives, and at AWS events/summits.
  
  
Identify repeatable patterns, contribute to internal knowledge repositories, and author customer-facing content such as reference architectures and whitepapers.
  
  
Collaborate with Account Managers and customer success teams to drive workload adoption, revenue growth, and long-term customer satisfaction.
  
  
**About The Team**
The FSI Solutions Architecture team at AWS India serves some of the country's largest and most innovative financial institutions. Our team is geographically distributed across Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru, and Gurugram, working closely with enterprise customers on their most critical technology transformation initiatives.
  
  
We operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and customer obsession. Our Solutions Architects are hands-on builders who design and validate architectures, engage with CxO-level stakeholders, and drive measurable business outcomes. The team culture values intellectual curiosity, ownership, bias for action, and a relentless focus on earning customer trust.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* Experience in networking fundamentals, security, databases (Relational and/or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
* Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
* Experience in building live-demos and prototypes
* Solid understanding of Generative AI concepts

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the financial services industry
* Experience working with data and analytics
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience with AI/ML technologies

Role Overview The Planning Solution Architect is the technical and functional visionary for the global supply chain planning landscape. This role is responsible for designing a seamless, end-to-end planning architecture that integrates Demand, Supply, Inventory, and S&OP processes. You will lead the strategic transition from legacy SAP APO environments to modern platforms like Kinaxis Maestro, ensuring that the organization achieves "Concurrent Planning" capabilities and real-time visibility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architectural Strategy: Design the target-state architecture for global planning, defining the co-existence or migration strategy between SAP APO, SAP IBP, and Kinaxis.
* End-to-End Planning Integration: Ensure seamless data and process flow between Demand Planning (DP), Supply Network Planning (SNP), and Production Planning/Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS) within the planning hub.
* Concurrent Planning Excellence: Configure Kinaxis to enable instant "what-if" scenario analysis, ensuring that a change in demand is immediately reflected across the entire supply network.
* Algorithm & Solver Optimization: Lead the selection and configuration of planning engines, including Heuristics, Optimizers (Linear Programming), and Statistical Forecasting models.
* S&OP Transformation: Architect the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process to align financial targets with operational capabilities, facilitating executive-level decision-making.
* Data Orchestration: Define the Master Data strategy (Material, Location, Resource, BOM, and Routing) required to sustain high-fidelity planning models across multiple tools.

Domain Expertise & Planning Principles
  
  

* Demand Management: Mastery of statistical forecasting, demand sensing, and collaborative forecasting.
* Supply & Capacity Planning: Deep understanding of Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP), constrained vs. unconstrained supply plans, and multi-level pegging.
* Inventory Optimization (IO): Experience in Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) to balance service levels against working capital.
* Response & Resupply: Designing logic for prioritized demand fulfillment and automated supply re-balancing during disruptions.

Technical Proficiency
  
  

* Kinaxis Maestro (RapidResponse): Expert-level knowledge of Authoring (Resources, Attributes, Workbooks), Task Flows, and Integration .
* SAP IBP: Hands-on experience with IBP Demand, IBP Supply & Response, and IBP Inventory modules, including configuration of Planning Areas and Key Figures.
* SAP APO: Deep legacy knowledge of DP and SNP; ability to extract business logic from APO to migrate to modern cloud platforms.
* Integration Technologies: Proficiency in integrating planning hubs with ERP backbones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA or ECC) using SAP CPI-DS, SDI, or flat-file interfaces.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in Supply Chain Planning IT, with at least 5 years as a Solution Architect.
* Implementation Track Record: Proven experience leading at least two global implementations involving the integration of Kinaxis or SAP IBP with a legacy SAP landscape.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or Information Technology.
* Certifications: Kinaxis Certified Author/Architect and/or SAP IBP Professional Certification.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strategic Communication: Ability to translate complex algorithmic logic (like Optimizer costs or Kinaxis heuristics) into clear business outcomes for stakeholders.
* Analytical Problem Solving: A "systems-thinking" mindset to identify how a planning configuration in one node affects the global network.
* Change Leadership: Experience guiding planning teams through the mindset shift from "Batch Processing" (APO) to "Continuous/Concurrent Planning" (Kinaxis/IBP).

We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

title: Senior Consultant - Middleware/OCP
description:
**About The Job**
The Red Hat India Services team is looking for a Consultant to join us in Mumbai, India. In this role, you will help us ensure that our engagements are not just a technology implementation, but an organizational transformation. As a consultant, you will work with our lead architect in our engagements, cocreating innovative software solutions using emerging open source technology and modern software design methods in an agile environment. You’ll be coached by the team to facilitate the design and technical delivery of our solutions. As you do so, you’ll create enthusiasm for building great software using principles of open source and agile culture. You'll support everything from the scoping to delivering the engagements. Successful applicants must reside in a city where Red Hat has mentioned the location.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Applies software engineering principles to the operations domain.
* Ensures service reliability meets users’ needs, including internally critical and externally visible services
* Uses software & systems engineering to design, build, and run large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems
* Develop API’s using Red Hat technology products and service
* Design, develop, and manage Kafka-based data pipelines
* Provide issue analysis on Kafka applications
* Monitor Kafka performance and troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and ensure uninterrupted data flow, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiency.
* Participates in an on-call rotation within a geographically distributed team to provide 24x7x365 production support, with responsibility to respond to urgent customer issues
* Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems
* Help us cover domains including microservices, API management, and web-scale architectures, DevOps engineering and application delivery, container-based continuous delivery (CD), i.e., using Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform,
* Team up with Red Hat and the open source community to engineer innovation-based software solutions, designed to further accelerate our customers’ success at their transformation journey
* Work as a trusted adviser to our customers and use your critical thinking skills to tackle tough problems in an innovative way
* Train and coach team members both on technical and non-technical skills
* Remain an active coder as this is required during our engagements and maintain deep direct technical knowledge of container management systems (CMSs), application infrastructure, architectures, and development solutions
* Support presales and post-sales field teams during workshops, proofs of concepts, pilots, and production deployments

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience and advanced knowledge of middleware technologies, including enterprise web or middleware development project experience with application integration
* Knowledge and some experience in OpenShift by Red Hat;
* Experience with another Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution will also be considered
* Hands on experience using Cloud as a development environment
* JEE and Middleware technology
* Good technical skills and experience designing and implementing JEE solutions.
* Thorough experience with at least one of the major middleware solutions, preferably Red Hat JBoss Middleware; experience in Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, WebMethods, Tibco, etc. will also be considered.
* Hands on experience in application development with Agile approach
* Hands on experience on building pipelines and CI/CD.
* Knowledge on Devops and Microservices
* Enterprise Java development skills are an advantage.
* Knowledge of Hibernate and Tomcat is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience on AMQ, API management like 3scale.
* Ability and desire to learn new technologies on your own and apply new concepts to problems

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with or knowledge of Red Hat’s technologies like Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, Red Hat Fuse, Red Hat 3Scale, Red Hat AMQ, or Red Hat AMQ Streams (Kafka)
* Working with some community technologies like Argo CD, Tekton Pipelines, Helm, or Jenkins
* Working with application and infrastructure monitoring
* Experience with or knowledge of JavaScript, Golang, Python, or Shell Scripting
* Experience with or knowledge of technologies AngularJS, React.js, and Vue.js

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
  
  
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

/ automation platforms and related automation solutions.

testing, and supporting automations.

automation.

desktop automation tools, or equivalent automation tools.

developers.

 Python knowledge.
