title: Senior Director - Cloud & AI Platform Engineering
description:
**What are we looking for**

*real solver?*

**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.**
We're searching for the architects of the audacious & the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.

**Your Mission: The Role**

solving for better.

You own delivery for Cloud & AI Platform Engineering: cloud foundations and migration, data platforms, AI and MLOps foundations, private AI, and the agent runtime that sits on top of them. Every CAPE engagement you lead ends with something running in production, with a named owner, at a cost the client can defend.

Most firms split this work into a cloud team, a data team, an AI team and a FinOps function on the side. Agents ignore those boundaries, so the failures land in the gaps between them. You run CAPE as one system, and you hold it to one bar: evidence from production, not a plan someone approved.

If you have led platform delivery at enterprise scale, you are fluent in how agents actually fail, and you treat utilisation and inference cost as seriously as architecture, this is your seat.

**Your Responsibilities**

*what you will wake up to solve.*

**‣Make the estate agent-ready**

* **Own platform delivery end to end:**
  Lead every CAPE engagement across landing zones, migration, data platforms, MLOps and private or sovereign AI, with running production systems as the finish line rather than approved plans.
* **Build the agent runtime properly:**
  Deliver durable execution, multi-agent orchestration, tool interoperability and agent observability, so client agents survive mid-run failures, act safely across systems, and can be operated by whoever inherits them.
* **Engineer what models can see:**
  Treat retrieval, context engineering and decision instrumentation as first-class deliverables, judged by the business decisions they improve.

**‣Run delivery on evidence, not optimism**

* **Own the delivery economics:**
  Be accountable for billable utilisation, effort efficiency and deviation from SOW across the CAPE portfolio, and make sure we have the people before we promise the work.
* **Deliver cost as an outcome:**
  Make cloud and AI economics part of the engagement: cost allocation, commitment restructuring and lower cost per AI task without a drop in quality, proven by measurement.
* **Report performance honestly:**
  Keep partner-funded work visible separately, so margin and utilisation reflect what the business unit actually earns.

**‣Nothing ships unowned**

* **Launch with an owner:**
  Every platform goes live with someone accountable for running it and the telemetry they need from day one.
* **Escalate early:**
  Surface risks to the client-facing lead before the client has to raise them.
* **Plan the next step at launch:**
  Every go-live comes with a view of what to improve next, so delivery becomes a relationship, not a closing date.

**‣Build the bench by route, not by default**

* **Hold the credential bar:**
  Set and enforce the certification and hands-on standard for cloud, data, ML and FinOps crafts, requalified on real delivery evidence, with leaders held to the same bar as engineers.
* **Choose build or buy per capability:**
  Grow existing strengths through training, and hire where the market is moving faster than training can, such as agent platform engineering.
* **Turn delivery into differentiation:**
  Maintain working accelerators for landing zones, agent platforms and retrieval, publish on what the team has learned, and represent Searce with our cloud and AI partners.

**Welcome to Searce**

*The ‘process-first’, AI-native modern tech consultancy that's rewriting the rules.*

**We don’t do traditional.**

As an engineering-led consultancy, we are dedicated to relentlessly improving the real business outcomes. Our solvers co-innovate with clients to
**futurify**
operations and make processes smarter, faster & better. We build alongside our clients. Not for the vanity metrics. But for the transformation to embed lasting competitive advantage for our clients.

The result? Modern business reinvention, built on math, tech, and clarity of purpose.

**Functional Skills**

* **Portfolio Judgment:**
  Reads a portfolio of concurrent engagements and knows which one breaks next, and why, before the dashboard turns red.
* **Delivery Economics:**
  Translates technical scope into effort, capacity, cost and margin, and knows which trade-off protects all of them.
* **Capability Strategy:**
  Decides, craft by craft, what to train, what to hire and what to stop offering, based on evidence rather than hope.
* **Standards that Hold:**
  Sets a quality bar people can be measured against, and holds it with leaders as firmly as with new joiners.
* **Executive Candour:**
  Delivers bad news early, with options, to client and internal leadership alike.

**Tech Superpowers**

* **Cloud Foundations and Migration:**
  Hands-on background in landing zones, networking, identity, infrastructure as code (Terraform), containerisation and large-scale migration on Google Cloud and AWS, at Professional Cloud Architect or Solutions Architect Professional depth.
* **Data Platform Engineering:**
  Lakehouse, streaming, data quality and lineage on platforms such as BigQuery, Databricks and Kafka.
* **AI and Agent Runtime:**
  MLOps on Vertex AI or SageMaker, open-weight model serving (vLLM), durable execution (Temporal or equivalent workflow engines), agent orchestration (LangGraph, Google ADK), Model Context Protocol, and agent tracing with OpenTelemetry or Langfuse.
* **Retrieval and Context:**
  Retrieval architecture, vector and hybrid search, permission-aware retrieval and retrieval-quality evaluation.
* **Cloud and AI Economics:**
  FinOps practice (allocation, showback, anomaly detection), committed-use and reserved-capacity instruments, and inference cost levers such as model routing, caching and batching.

**Experience & Relevance**

* **Experience:**
  12+ years in cloud, data or platform engineering, including 7+ years leading delivery across multiple client engagements and crafts.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent.
* **Track Record:**
  Has taken enterprise platforms that run AI or agent workloads into production for multiple clients.
* **Still Builds:**
  Has personally shipped something with a large language model in the recent past, not only overseen a team that did.
* **Team Scale:**
  Has led a delivery organisation of engineers and architects across more than one craft.

**Join the ‘real solvers’**

ready to futurify?

If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI-native engineering-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses, apply here and experience the ‘
*Art of the possible*
’.

**Don’t Just Send a Resume. Send a Statement.**

description:

**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: EHS&S Digital Solution Specialist
description:

, based in
**Navi Mumbai (India)**
to join the
**Environment, Health, Safety and Sustainability (EHS&S)**
Information Technology team. **Responsibilities**

* Experience Mapping: Translate user journeys and stories into solutions that enhance employee and customer experience (EX/CX).
* Solution Lifecycle Management: Drive end-to-end lifecycle—design, architecture, integration (buy vs. build), development, testing, and compliance with corporate standards and security policies.
* Adoption & Support: Support implementation, user adoption, and define supplier/team support models.
* Performance Management: Establish controls, KPIs, and measures for solution performance and reliability.
* Integration & Optimization: Coordinate with Solution Managers and Business Process Managers for end-to-end process integration.
* Roadmap Development: Define improvement and innovation roadmaps; assess resources, technology, and investment needs.
* Team Support: Assist senior Solution Managers with workload analysis and capacity planning.
* Ability to analyze and resolve problems using technical expertise and sound judgment. Strong communication skills to explain complex concepts and provide informal guidance to new team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, EHS&S, or a related field.
* Min 5+ years of work experience in the role.
* Knowledge and experience with EHS and Sustainability processes and technologies.
* Experience supporting sustainability, decarbonization, carbon accounting, environmental compliance, product carbon footprint (PCF), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) initiatives through digital solutions and data-driven capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and automation technologies.
* Strong understanding of system integration and application architecture, including API integrations, data flow analysis, end-to-end process integration, and Azure Integration Services.
* Experience working with Databricks, SQL, and Azure DevOps.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate) and Copilot solutions.
* Knowledge of software development concepts and modern application delivery practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Understanding of cloud-based technologies, enterprise data management, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Your Skills**

* Business Requirements: The ability to gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements that guide the design and delivery of effective digital solutions.
* Solutions Delivery: Managing the full lifecycle of digital solutions—including design, integration, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and retirement—to ensure they meet performance, security, and usability expectations.
* Design Thinking: Applying user‑centered methods such as journey mapping and experience analysis to create solutions that improve employee and customer experience while driving simplification, automation, and efficiency.
* Integration Services: Coordinating and defining end‑to‑end system and process integrations to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across applications, platforms, and business processes.
* Strategic Planning: Developing solution roadmaps, identifying digital innovation opportunities, and aligning technology investments and resource needs with organizational strategy and long‑term business goals environment.

**Additional Notes**

* The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential.
* Relocation assistance is not provided with this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.

* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.

* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.

+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**

* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI

Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.

**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
  
  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability

development within the team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Technical Experience And Skills**

* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in

mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset-intensive environments.
  
  

* Proficiency in Python and experience with relevant AI, data science, or machine learning libraries and frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or generative AI application development.
* Knowledge of data engineering concepts, ETL or ELT pipelines, APIs, structured and unstructured data processing, and system integration.
* Experience with OCR, document processing, computer vision, layout analysis, or multimodal AI techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-based AI and data services.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**

**Company Description**
Future Technologies and Services India is a growing technology and services organization established in 2021, focused on delivering future-ready solutions to clients. The company operates across multiple domains, including software development, web and mobile app development, IT training, digital marketing, financial services, recruitment, and project outsourcing. With a flexible network of in-house professionals and freelancers, Future Technologies and Services India tailors its services to customer requirements and strives for continuous improvement. The organization supports a wide range of technical roles such as PHP, .NET, Angular, Android, iOS, and Java development, offering opportunities to work on diverse projects and technology stacks.

The Application Architect / Integration Architect role is an on-site position based in Navi Mumbai, focused on designing and implementing scalable, secure, and high-performance application and integration architectures within the banking/BFSI domain. The role involves translating business requirements into technical solutions, defining architecture standards, evaluating technologies, and ensuring seamless integration across enterprise systems. The architect will assess existing systems, resolve architectural challenges, design new solutions, and collaborate with development, consulting, and operations teams to ensure alignment with business objectives. The role also includes planning architectural improvements, supporting cloud migration strategies, optimizing system performance, assessing technology options based on cost and scalability, and establishing architecture best practices.

* Minimum 12+ years of total professional experience, with at least 5 years of banking/BFSI experience.
* Educational qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. BE/BTech is preferred; candidates with other undergraduate degrees must have a full-time MCA, MTech, or MSc in a relevant IT/Computer Science field.
* Strong expertise in Application Architecture, Integration Architecture, and Solution Design.
* Ability to design new (Greenfield) architectures and resolve issues in existing (Brownfield) architectures.
* Experience assessing infrastructure, applications, data, cloud environments, and system performance.
* Ability to evaluate and plan migration from monolithic banking systems to cloud-based environments, considering timelines, cost, quality, capacity, and risk.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technologies and the ability to compare platforms such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud based on suitability, advantages, limitations, and commercial costs.
* For Application Architects: knowledge of Java/.NET, application design, UI frameworks, Azure Architecture, Java EE, and TOGAF.
* For Integration Architects: expertise in IBM Integration, MuleSoft, APIs, middleware, message queues (MQ), Kafka, and integration design.

description:

**Business Descriptor**
Brief Job Description
  
  
Chief Technology Officer for India Asset Management is responsible for defining and delivering the end-to-end technology strategy and roadmap, enabling secure, scalable and resilient platforms across distribution, investment and operations. This role leads engineering and technology delivery while ensuring strong operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and effective management of technology risk and third-party partners.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Set technology strategy & roadmap for India Asset Management aligned to business priorities, global standards, and local regulatory expectations.
* Lead technology delivery across digital, distribution, investment and operations platforms; govern prioritisation, milestones, and benefits realisation.
* Run stable, resilient services: own production reliability, incident/problem management, Disaster Recovery(DR)/Business Continuity Plan(BCP) readiness, capacity planning, and observability.
* Modernise engineering practices: Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), DevSecOps, test automation, Site Reliability Engineering(SRE) practices, API-first integration, and platform reuse/simplification.
* Own technology risk, security & compliance: security-by-design, control effectiveness, audit readiness, vulnerability remediation, and third-party risk management.
* Build data & analytics capabilities: data platform direction, governance (quality/lineage/ownership), and fit-for-purpose MI/regulatory reporting.
* Manage vendors, sourcing & budgets: commercial performance, delivery assurance, and cost optimisation (run vs change), including legacy decommissioning.
* Partner with senior stakeholders across business, operations, risk/compliance, and group technology to translate outcomes into executable plans.

Technical competency (what the role should be strong in)
  
  

* Asset/Wealth domain technology: distribution and client servicing journeys, onboarding/KYC, order management and post-trade integration, reporting/MI.
* Architecture & integration: API design/management, event-driven patterns, microservices (where appropriate), enterprise integration, and system interoperability.
* Cloud & infrastructure (hybrid): cloud-native concepts, containerisation, resilience patterns, networking basics, and environment standardisation.
* Operational resilience & Site Reliability Engineering(SRE): monitoring/alerting, Service Level Agreements(SLAs), incident response, root cause analysis, capacity/performance engineering, Disaster Recovery(DR) design/testing.
* Security engineering: secure Software Development Life Cycle(SDLC), Identity and Access Management (IAM), secrets management, encryption, vulnerability management, and security controls embedded in pipelines.
* Data platforms & governance: data modelling basics, Extract Transform Load(ETL)/Extract Load and Transfer(ELT) patterns, data quality controls, lineage, and regulatory reporting readiness.
* DevSecOps toolchains: Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, automated testing, artefact management, code quality scanning, and release governance.
* Vendor/third-party technology management: integration oversight, service performance management, and technology risk assessment of suppliers.

**Requirements**
Experience: 15–25 years of experience; prior experience in SEBI regulated organisation is preferred
  
  
**Minimum Graduation or as required for the role, whichever is higher**

title: Salesforce Application Architect
description:
SOVOS
  
  
Salesforce Application Architect
  
  
Accounting/Finance·Full-Time·India
  
  
Build Your Future With Us
  
  
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
  
  
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
  
  
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
  
  
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

What You Bring to Sovos
  
  

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.

title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities.
  
Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation.
  
  
 
  
**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus
  

* Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities.
* Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features.
* Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management.
* Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership
* Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare.
* Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation.
* Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns.
* Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
* Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance.
* Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose.
* Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues.
* Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
* Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases.
* Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption.

  
Operational Management
  

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues.
* Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk.
* Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation.
* Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.

  
  
People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership 
  
 
  
  

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners.
* Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors.
* Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits.
* Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams.

  
Governance, Security and Risk
  

* Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements.
* Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners.
* Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance.
* Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options.
* Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs.
  
  
 
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous.
* Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI.
* Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support.
* Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes.
* Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous.
* Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation.
* Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review.
* Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including structured diagnosis of complex integration, data, security and configuration issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical options, trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong planning, prioritisation and delivery discipline, with the ability to manage concurrent initiatives and production priorities.
* High standards of integrity, discretion and care when handling employee and organisational data.
* Practical, collaborative and outcomes-focused, with the confidence to work with limited supervision, manage multiple priorities, challenge weak assumptions and escalate material risks.

Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
  
  
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
  
  
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
  
  
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

What You Bring to Sovos
  
  

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.
* Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer.
* Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale.
* Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance.
* Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process
  
  
We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
  
  
1
  
  
Pre-Employment Assessment
  
  
Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
  
  
2
  
  
Video Interview
  
  
A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
  
  
3
  
  
Meeting with a Recruiter
  
  
A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
  
  
4
  
  
Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
  
  
Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
  
  
Life at Sovos
  
  
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
  
  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
**Company Background**
Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
  
  
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

title: VP – Applied AI Architect - Process Re-engineering CoE
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  

* Decompose complex insurance, asset-management and finance processes and identify deterministic, AI-assisted and human-controlled steps.
* Produce current-state and target-state architectures, architecture decision records and non-functional requirements for automation and AI solutions.
* Select the appropriate automation mechanism for each problem — rules engine, workflow, RPA, traditional ML, LLM, RAG or human decision — and justify the choice.
* Design and build AI solutions using enterprise Copilot capabilities and direct API calls to the leading LLM providers, with a provider-independent abstraction layer.
* Engineer secure, permission-aware retrieval (RAG) over enterprise knowledge, preserving source-system permissions and information barriers.
* Integrate solutions with systems of record — recordkeeping platforms, Salesforce and Oracle Fusion — via APIs, events and controlled RPA where APIs are unavailable.
* Design bounded-autonomy agentic workflows in which a deterministic orchestrator owns process state, approvals, audit and compensation.
* Establish AI evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, groundedness, hallucination and regression testing) linked to business KPIs.
* Embed responsible-AI, security and financial-services controls: segregation of duties, maker-checker, materiality thresholds, explainability and evidence retention.
* Stand up LLMOps/MLOps — versioning, monitoring, cost/FinOps controls, fallback routing and incident management — for production operation.
* Baseline processes and prove value realisation using BI, analytics and process mining

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Founding Engineer | IIT/BITS
description:
**Founding Engineer | IIT/BITS**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Role: Full time, Founding Team**

**Joining: November**

Looking for an engineer who is also an Entrepreneur, Builder and Mr. Figureoutable at heart to join our founding team.

**About Us:**

We are a D2C brand led by IITR alum. We are pre-launch and have raised pre-seed funding backed by founders of Souled Store, TIGC, partners from Investment banking, and strong startup operators.

We aim to become a 5000 Crore brand by 2030 and tech would be at the core of how we achieve this goal.

**But why hire in tech for a D2C brand?**

We're building what we hope will be
**one of India's first truly AI-native, tech-first D2C brands.**

* Not a D2C company that occasionally uses ChatGPT.
* A company where AI and technology are at the core of how we operate, make decisions, serve customers, and scale

Thus we are looking for a
**Founding Engineer cum AI builder**

to make this happen.

**Who are we looking for?**

* A strong full-stack engineer, AI enthusiast, problem solver, and someone with serious entrepreneurial energy.
* Has a high bias for action. You'd rather ship something in 3 days than discuss it for 3 weeks.
* Someone who can independently take products from idea to deployment.
* Can build for web and mobile (or is confident in figuring out what they don't know).
* Is genuinely excited about, stays highly updated and has built products using AI, LLMs, agents, and automation.
* Thinks like a founder, not just an engineer.
* Loves ownership, ambiguity, and figuring things out.
* Bachelors from tier-1 colleges - IIT/BITS/IIIT
* Bonus: Experience building AI agents, agentic AI systems which are being used on production and at scale would be a big plus
* Bonus: ex-founders, ex-founding engineer at funded startups

**What will you actually do?**

Pretty much everything tech.

* Build our website, mobile app, and customer-facing experiences.
* Build AI agents and automate workflows across marketing, operations, customer experience, and more.
* Experiment with new AI tools, ship quickly, break things, fix things.
* Own the entire tech stack, from writing code to deploying products.
* Eventually help build the tech team as we scale.

**Why this should be exciting?**

* Because you will one of the first few engineers in India who will build a real-life case study on building brands in the age of AI.
* You'll get to experiment with technology across the entire business, not just a product; and you get to see the impact your work is bringing.
* If you have that entrepreneurial itch, this could be one of the most interesting ways to scratch it.
* It's the perfect opportunity if you are looking for a role that could be a stepping stone before building your own startup

**Important Disclaimer**

* **This might come with a pay cut.**

  If maximizing your salary over the next 12 months is your top priority, this probably isn't the right opportunity.
* We're looking for someone optimizing for
  **ownership, learning, building incredible things, and long-term upside.**
* There will be meaningful ESOPs, real decision-making power, and a chance to build something that becomes a case study talked about globally.

**﻿

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

**Director, Engineering - Autonomous Platform**
**What You'll Do**

* As the Director of Engineering for Teradata's Autonomous Platform, you will lead and grow two engineering teams responsible for building and delivering core agentic AI-powered platform capabilities: Autonomous Data Platform (ADP) and Workload Management (WLM). You will define and drive the execution of the technical roadmap, ensure engineering excellence, and partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable AI-driven solutions.
* You will play a key role in transforming innovative AI concepts into production-ready platform capabilities while building and mentoring high-performing engineering teams that support Teradata's next generation of autonomous and knowledge-driven products.

* Lead, mentor, and develop multiple engineering teams spanning platform engineering, AI/ML, and distributed systems.
* Build and scale high-performing teams; attract, retain, and grow top technical talent in agentic AI, developer platforms, and cloud infrastructure.

title: Senior, AI Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
Join the EisnerAI team, a fast-growing organization within EisnerAmper that is redefining how professional services harness the power of Artificial Intelligence. As an AI Engineer specializing in MLOps and AIOps, you will play a critical role in deploying, operating, and optimizing enterprise-grade AI solutions built on Azure, collaborating closely with AI Developers, Product Owners, Governance leaders and Cloud Architects to ensure these systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-effective across tax, audit, advisory, and client-facing applications. This role goes beyond traditional DevOps—it’s about engineering AI into the fabric of enterprise operations, enabling secure, observable, and governed machine learning deployments that deliver real business impact.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards

+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**

* Deploy and monitor AI models across Azure services with robust telemetry for performance, drift, and availability.
* Manage model upgrades including APIs and UIs with structured rollout, version control, and rollback support.
* Optimize performance and cost through testing, profiling, and tuning of inference infrastructure and pipelines.
* Implement MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, deployment, and lifecycle management using Azure ML and GitHub Actions.
* Ensure compliant change management for all AI-related deployments, with auditability, security, and governance controls.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field
* 3+ years in MLOps and/or AIOps, ideally within Azure cloud environment with hands-on experience with Azure ML, Synapse, Data Lake, App Services, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Foundry

**Preferred/Desired Qualifications**

* Consulting background with a strong bias for action.
* Workflow Design: Prompt flow, automation pipelines, and human-in-the-loop systems
* Post-Training Techniques: Fine-tuning, instruction tuning, RLHF, and domain adaptation
* Azure DevOps, App Insights, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Managed Identity integration.
* Tools for inference performance testing and profiling (e.g., locust, K6, or custom scripts).
* Model Evaluation: Performance metrics, benchmark development, and A/B testing frameworks
* Understanding of model observability, telemetry, and incident response for AI systems.

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 5000 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.
