title: AI / ML Modelling Engineer
description:
**About Business Line/Function**
The AML IT function sits within the BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) CEFS‑technology ecosystem and provides end‑to‑end technology platform that enables the bank’s anti‑money‑laundering (AML) program. Its core purpose is to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into robust, scalable, and secure IT solutions that detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity across the Group’s global operations.
  
  
The AML IT business line is the technology backbone that transforms raw transaction data into actionable AML intelligence, ensuring that BNP Paribas CIB meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining operational resilience and innovation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The role centers on creating next‑generation AML capabilities and will be instrumental in protecting the BNPP Group from fraud, money‑laundering, and other financial crimes by using advanced technologies and innovative solutions.
  
  
As an AI-ML Engineer, you will design, train and deploy machine learning models that detect money laundering and financial crime. This position is vital for shaping the core detection capability of the platform. This also involves execution of various AML initiatives, thereby strengthening the organization’s overall risk management.
  
  
While direct AML experience is not mandatory, a strong foundation in machine learning, sound engineering practices, and a willingness to learn the financial-crime domain are essential. Familiarity with regulated environments, model governance, or fraud and anomaly detection is an advantage, but we are primarily looking for engineers who can build robust, well-calibrated, production-grade models and reason carefully about their real-world impact. The role will operate within a globally distributed environment.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Development & Evaluation – Design, train, and assess ML models (NNs, GNNs, gradient‑boosted ensembles, unsupervised anomaly detectors) for money‑laundering detection across transaction, client, and network levels.
* Feature Engineering Pipeline – Build and optimise Spark/Delta Lake pipelines, ensuring feature consistency between training and production.
* Lifecycle Management – Track experiments, version models, and run champion‑challenger workflows with MLflow.
* Low‑Latency Deployment – Deploy and maintain inference services (e.g., BentoML) on the on‑prem Kubernetes platform.
* Calibration & Scoring – Calibrate models and map scores to probabilities to deliver reliable, decision‑ready risk scores.
* Explainability & Governance – Provide model explainability for audits, document design/assumptions/validation, and guarantee full reproducibility and auditability for regulatory compliance.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Partner with data engineers, graph/LLM specialists, and compliance analysts to translate detection requirements into production‑ready models.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Python engineering & secure code – Expert in object‑oriented, modular, and reusable Python code; packaging, logging, metrics, and tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); security primitives (OAuth2/JWT) and data‑privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA).
* ML modeling & calibration – Hands‑on with PyTorch (custom architectures, focal loss, training loops, GPU optimization), XGBoost/LightGBM, scikit‑learn/Keras/TensorFlow; deep knowledge of model calibration (Platt scaling, score‑to‑probability, MC‑Dropout), evaluation (PR/AUC‑ROC, F‑beta, lift charts) and handling class imbalance along with the underlying statistical concepts (calibration theory, hypothesis testing).
* Large‑scale data processing – Proficient in Pandas, Dask, Polars (or equivalent) for transactional‑scale datasets; feature engineering, distributed pipelines, and performance‑aware data handling.
* MLOps & lifecycle management – MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, stage promotion), BentoML (runners, adaptive batching, CPU/GPU pools), GitOps/Argo CD for A/B‑testing and champion‑challenger workflows; CI/CD pipelines with Git/Bitbucket.
* Python microservices & containerization – Designing and deploying APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or Django; async I/O, Celery task queues, Docker packaging, and Kubernetes orchestration for scalable inference services.
* Data storage & query optimization – Strong command of SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL/graph stores (Cassandra, MongoDB, Neo4j, JanusGraph); schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ); cross‑team and multi‑geography collaboration, rapid technology adoption, mentorship, and end‑to‑end ownership of solutions.
* Strong collaboration and learning mindset, with the ability to work across teams and geographies, adapt to new technologies, mentor others, and take end-to-end ownership.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience with W&B alongside MLflow.
* Evidently AI or similar drift/monitoring platforms
* DVC or LakeFS for dataset versioning
* TorchServe / Triton / KServe (alternative serving paths)
* Exposure to large scale data or streaming platforms such as Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks in high volume processing contexts.

**Education Level**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level
  
  
At least 7 years
  
  
**Job Title**
AIML\_Engineer
  
  
**Date**
18/05/2026
  
  
**Department**
CEP IT
  
  
Location:
  
  
Mumbai
  
  
Business Line
  
  
Anti Money Laundering
  
  
**Reports To**
AML IT Manager
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Collaboration & Messaging (SharePoint)
description:
**Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint)**
The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) is a senior technical practitioner responsible specifically for the engineering, administration, governance, reliability, migration, and continuous improvement of the firm’s enterprise SharePoint Online environment. This role serves as the technical subject matter expert for SharePoint within the Messaging and Productivity Platforms function. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include**
The engineer will own the technical administration and engineering of SharePoint Online and play a significant role in SharePoint migrations, tenant consolidations, mergers and acquisitions, content remediation, lifecycle management, governance, and automation.
  
  
**SharePoint Online Administration & Engineering**

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve the enterprise SharePoint Online environment.
* Maintain tenant-level SharePoint configurations and administrative controls.
* Establish and maintain standards for site architecture, provisioning, permissions, ownership, sharing, and lifecycle management.
* Manage and monitor SharePoint storage, site collections, access, configuration, and platform health.
* Develop scalable technical solutions for SharePoint administration and management.
* Evaluate SharePoint Online product changes and assess their potential impact on the enterprise environment.
* Plan, test, and implement SharePoint platform changes in a controlled and supportable manner.
* Identify and remediate stale, abandoned, redundant, orphaned, or improperly configured SharePoint sites.
* Develop automation using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, and other appropriate technologies.
* Reduce manual SharePoint administration through repeatable engineering and automation.

**SharePoint Migration Engineering;**

* Plan and execute enterprise SharePoint Online migrations.
* Support SharePoint migrations associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, tenant consolidations, and organizational transformation.
* Perform technical discovery and assessment of source SharePoint environments.
* Analyze sites, content, permissions, metadata, links, customizations, dependencies, and other migration considerations.
* Determine migration readiness and identify technical risks, remediation requirements, and dependencies.
* Develop migration strategies, technical migration plans, sequencing, migration waves, validation procedures, and rollback approaches.
* Configure and operate enterprise SharePoint migration technologies.
* Develop scripts and automation to improve migration discovery, preparation, execution, validation, and reporting.
* Troubleshoot complex migration failures and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
* Perform pre- and post-migration validation of content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality.
* Identify obsolete, redundant, unsupported, or unnecessary content and determine appropriate remediation rather than automatically carrying technical debt into the destination environment.
* Develop repeatable migration processes and standards that can be reused for future migration initiatives.
* Transition migrated environments into established SharePoint governance and lifecycle-management processes.

**SharePoint Governance & Lifecycle Management**

* Establish and maintain enterprise SharePoint governance standards.
* Define and maintain standards for site provisioning, ownership, permissions, external sharing, and lifecycle.
* Establish processes for identifying and managing inactive, abandoned, and orphaned sites.
* Support site expiration, archival, retention, and decommissioning processes.
* Maintain appropriate controls for external and guest sharing.
* Partner with Information Security on SharePoint security and data-protection requirements.
* Partner with Identity & Access Management on SharePoint authentication, access, guest identity, and related access-management requirements.
* Improve visibility into SharePoint ownership, usage, storage, health, and lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to reduce SharePoint technical debt and platform sprawl.

**Advanced SharePoint Troubleshooting**

* Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex SharePoint Online issues.
* Troubleshoot complex permissions, authentication, access, sharing, configuration, content, and migration problems.
* Investigate issues that cannot be effectively resolved through established frontline or second-level support processes.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions where possible.
* Identify patterns across escalated incidents that indicate broader platform or governance problems.
* Engage Microsoft and SharePoint technology vendors when vendor-level escalation is required.
* Document solutions and transfer repeatable troubleshooting knowledge to appropriate support teams.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience administering and engineering enterprise SharePoint environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with SharePoint Online in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong experience with enterprise SharePoint administration, configuration, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large-scale SharePoint migrations.
* Experience with SharePoint Online tenant-to-tenant migrations or similar complex enterprise migration initiatives.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint architecture, sites, permissions, sharing, metadata, storage, and content structures.
* Experience performing technical discovery and migration-readiness assessments.
* Experience identifying migration dependencies, risks, technical debt, and remediation requirements.
* Experience validating content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality following migrations.
* Strong PowerShell and PnP PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
* Experience using Microsoft Graph, APIs, or other automation technologies for SharePoint administration.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint security, permissions, guest access, and external sharing.
* Experience troubleshooting complex SharePoint Online platform and migration issues.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex technical problems.
* Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, retention, and data-governance requirements.
* Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to independently drive complex technical work across multiple technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise SharePoint migration platforms such as ShareGate or equivalent technologies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or tenant consolidations involving SharePoint.
* Experience migrating SharePoint Server or other legacy SharePoint environments to SharePoint Online.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview capabilities relevant to SharePoint, including retention, information protection, and eDiscovery.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, guest access, and external identity capabilities as they relate to SharePoint.
* Experience with SharePoint site lifecycle automation and enterprise governance tooling.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph and API-based SharePoint automation.
* Relevant Microsoft 365 or SharePoint certifications.
* Experience working within a global enterprise and with managed service providers.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.

We are AudioCodes, (NASDAQ: AUDC) a global leader in voice communications, voice AI, Unified Communications, Contact Center, and AI-powered customer experience solutions. title: SAP BTP Architect-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**SAP BTP Architect**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**SAP BTP Architect**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a SAP BTP Architect with 10 to 15 years of relevant experience to join our dynamic team. This role designing and governing scalable, secure, and cloud‑native solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). The role focuses on application architecture using CAPM and/or RAP, side‑by‑side extensibility, and embedding SAP Business AI capabilities while ensuring Clean Core compliance across SAP landscapes.
  
  

* Define end‑to‑end solution architecture on SAP BTP
* Design application extensions using:

+ CAPM (Node.js/Java) and/or
+ RAP (ABAP Cloud, CDS, OData V4)

* Define extensibility strategy aligned with Clean Core principles
* Architect cloud‑native, multi‑tenant, and scalable applications
* Integrate applications with S/4HANA (Public & Private Cloud) and non‑SAP systems
* Design and embed SAP Business AI scenarios, including:

+ SAP AI Business Services (e.g., Document Information Extraction, DAR)
+ Generative AI via AI Core / Generative AI Hub

* Ensure enterprise‑grade security, governance, and compliance
* Review designs, perform architectural governance, and guide delivery teams
* Drive POCs, innovation initiatives, and reuse frameworks
* Mentor developers, leads, and managers on BTP architecture and best practices
* Support pre‑sales, estimations, and technical solutioning where required

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in SAP BTP architecture e.g. Event driven, Micro service based

**Hands‑on experience with:**

* BTP Accounts & cloud principles
* CAPM (CDS, services, events, multitenancy)
* RAP / Advance ABAP for cloud, Design Patterns & OOPS
* Runtime environment ( Cloud foundry, kyma and ABAP )
* OData V4
* SAP Fiori Elements / UI5

**Deep understanding of:**

* Clean Core & Side‑by‑Side extensibility
* S/4HANA Cloud extensibility models

**Experience with SAP Business AI, including:**

* AI Business Services
* AI Core & AI Launchpad
* Generative AI integration patterns
* Strong stakeholder, leadership, and communication skills

**Preferred Skills:**

* SAP Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Build Process Automation
* DevOps, CI/CD, and Transport Management on BTP

**SAP Certifications:**

* SAP BTP
* CAPM / ABAP Cloud / RAP
* SAP Business AI

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Head of Technology
description:
**Company Description**

Waya is a SEBI-registered investment advisory platform that uses AI-driven predictive models to help Indian investors make better market decisions. Founded in 2023, we are bootstrapped, profitable and serve 1 lakh+ paying users, acquired and served fully digitally.

•
**Products:**

Waya Equity (short-term and multibagger ideas), Waya FnO (index and stock options,

intraday, BTST), Waya MCX (gold, silver, crude and other commodities) and Waya PMS, a small -

cap portfolio management service for HNI’s.

•
**Registrations:**

SEBI Research Analyst (INH000010876) and Portfolio Manager (INP000008987).

•
**Platforms:**

Web at

thewaya.com

and the Waya mobile apps on Android and iOS.

**Role Description**

The Head of Technology owns everything Waya builds and runs: the apps, the website, the backend, the data and the AI. You will set the technical direction, lead every engineering team, and stay hands-on enough to review architecture and code.Your mandate is to turn a profitable, fast-growing advisory business into a technology platform that scales to millions of investors. That means reliable systems during market hours, an AI-first engineering culture, and shipping WayaX into production.

**Key responsibilities**

**Technology strategy and architecture**

• Own the technology roadmap with the founder, tied to revenue, user growth and product

launches.

• Define the target architecture across apps, web, backend services, data pipelines and AI

systems.

• Make build-vs-buy calls on market data vendors, broker and exchange APIs, cloud and AI model

providers.

• Own the technology budget, including cloud, data feeds and LLM spend.

**App and frontend**

• Lead the Flutter team building Waya's Android, iOS and web apps.

• Set standards for Clean Architecture/MVVM, state management (Bloc, Riverpod, Provider) and

Figma-based design systems.

• Drive a fast, smooth experience for live market updates, alerts and push notifications.

• Own App Store and Google Play releases, ratings and crash-free rates.

**Backend and platform**

• Lead the backend team working in PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter) and the services behind

subscriptions, CMS, advisory delivery and analytics.

• Plan the move from today's stack to a scalable, service-oriented platform where it pays off.

• Own integrations with payment gateways (UPI, BillDesk), Firebase, messaging channels and

third-party APIs.

• Keep systems up and fast during market hours, with clear SLAs, monitoring and on-call.

**AI engineering and WayaX**

• Lead the AI team building WayaX and the LLM features inside Waya's advisory products.

• Guide the design of multi-agent workflows, router agents, tool and function calling, MCP servers

and RAG pipelines.

• Set up evaluations, guardrails and observability so AI answers stay accurate, compliant and

consistent.

• Manage model choice, cost and latency across Claude, GPT and open-source LLMs.

**Data mining and analytics**

• Lead the data team that collects, cleans and stores market data: prices, F&O chains,

fundamentals, filings, corporate actions and commodities.

• Build the pipelines and data warehouse that feed Waya's predictive models, research and

WayaX.• Work with research analysts to turn their models and rules into production-grade data products.

• Own product analytics: funnels, retention, conversion and user behaviour.

**Security, compliance and reliability**

• Protect client data, payments and credentials with strong security practices and regular audits.

• Make sure systems meet SEBI requirements for Research Analysts and PMS, including record

keeping, disclosures, audit trails and cybersecurity norms.

• Run DevOps and CI/CD: Git-based pipelines, automated testing, cloud infrastructure, backups

and disaster recovery.

**AI-first engineering culture**

• Make AI-assisted development the default: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor and GitHub

Copilot across every team.

• Set the rules for reviewing, testing and maintaining AI-generated code, so speed never costs

quality or security.

• Coach engineers in workflow design with AI: breaking down problems, sequencing prompts, and

knowing when to push back on output.

**People leadership**

• Hire, lead and grow a team of backend, frontend, AI and data engineers.

• Set goals, run reviews, and build a culture of ownership and fast, careful shipping.

• Run sprint planning and delivery with product, research, marketing and customer support

teams.

**What we are looking for**

•
**Experience:**

12+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years leading teams that span mobile,

backend and data or AI.

•
**Consumer scale:**

You have built and run consumer products used by lakhs of users, ideally in

fintech, broking, trading, wealth or payments.

•
**Architecture:**

Deep grasp of distributed systems, APIs, databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching,

queues and real-time data delivery.

•
**Mobile and web:**

Strong working knowledge of Flutter/Dart or comparable cross-platform

stacks, and of modern web frontends.

•
**Backend:**

Hands-on background in at least one of PHP (Laravel), Python, Node.js, Go or Java, and

comfort leading teams in the others.

•
**AI and LLMs:**

Practical experience shipping LLM features: agents, function calling, RAG, vector

databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or similar), evaluations and guardrails.

•
**Data:**

Experience building data pipelines and warehouses, ideally on market or transaction data.

•
**AI-assisted engineering:**

You use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and know how

to steer, review and test what they produce.

•
**Cloud and DevOps:**

AWS, GCP or Azure; CI/CD; monitoring; security best practices.

•
**Leadership:**

A record of hiring strong engineers, raising delivery speed and keeping quality high.

•
**Education:**

B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus.

title: Software Architect
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Mumbai,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Software Architect to lead the design and evolution of complex enterprise software solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices. This role requires strong technical leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence engineering teams across multiple products and organizations.
  
  
The Software Architect will be responsible for defining technical vision, ensuring architectural consistency, driving innovation, mentoring technical teams, and delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Define end-to-end software architecture for large-scale products and platforms.
* Translate business requirements and non-functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Create and maintain high-level and low-level architecture designs.
* Establish architectural standards, design principles, and best practices.
* Review and approve architecture proposals, technical designs, and major engineering decisions.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle.
* Strong background of cloud native/Microservices
* Hands on experience in leveraging AI for SDLC

**Product & Technology Strategy**

* Drive technology roadmap and long-term architectural vision.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies.
* Ensure scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability of solutions.
* Balance business objectives, delivery timelines, and technical debt.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, and technical governance forums.
* Guide teams in implementing microservices, cloud-native, and distributed architectures.
* Define coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Champion DevOps, CI/CD, automation, observability, and operational excellence.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Product Management, Engineering Managers, Program Managers, QA, DevOps, and Architects.
* Communicate architecture decisions to both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Collaborate across global teams and influence architectural direction across multiple products.

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 10% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes
  
  
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

description:

title: Solutions Acceleration Architect, Google Cloud
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in cloud computing, with a focus on machine learning architecture, software development, and model deployment in a customer-facing or consulting role.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming/scripting languages such as Python.
* Experience developing and deploying data solutions.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating ambiguous customer requirements into actionable AI roadmaps, defining the technical architecture for fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and custom model development.
* Experience in architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems.
* Proven track record of managing stakeholder expectations and building consensus around complex AI initiatives, including navigating discussions on AI ethics, model bias, and return on investment (ROI).
* Understanding of the AI/ML landscape, including familiarity with model evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, and the integration of third-party foundation models.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
The APAC Google Forge Team partners with customers to bring their goals to life. We collaborate closely to understand their challenges and ideas, then design and build practical working solutions using data, analytics, AI, and software engineering. Our goal is to demonstrate how these technologies can work together to achieve impactful business results.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the design and development of cutting-edge prototypes, demonstrating the transformative power of data, analytics, AI, and software engineering to solve complex business challenges for our customers. You will play a key role in mentoring team members and contributing to the strategic direction of our solution-building efforts.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical relationship with partners, empowering them to drive a successful pilot or proof-of-concept, support partners in driving customer acceptance of the technical proposal, leading to an agreement, and work with partners during the migration phase to ensure they have all the tools necessary to deliver a successful deployment.
* Build trusted advisory relationships and make recommendations on integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution for customers to optimize Google Cloud effectiveness.
* Lead the design, development, and iterative refinement of data-centric and AI-powered solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), showcasing the potential of data and AI to address specific business needs.
* Establish and promote innovative best practices and methodologies for AI-driven solutions, actively contributing to industry thought leadership through publications, presentations, and community engagement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. * Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM configuration, customization, and solution delivery.
* Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with hands-on experience in plugins and workflows.
* Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, and business processes.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable system architectures.
* Proven problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to quality and performance.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in collaborative, Agile teams.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)

* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Director, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
**Your team**
Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest-growing businesses within Aladdin and represents a significant strategic investment for BlackRock. The team builds and operates the technology platforms that power accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Our engineers develop business-critical application, data, reporting, and workflow systems while driving modernization through distributed architectures, advanced data platforms, and engineering innovation. Working closely with Product, Operations, Data, and Engineering partners, the team delivers capabilities that support BlackRock and the broader Aladdin client ecosystem.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As an Engineering Director, Application Engineering, you will serve as a senior technology leader responsible for shaping architecture, engineering strategy, and delivery across enterprise-scale platforms supporting global post-trade operations. You will connect long-term technology vision with pragmatic execution, influence critical technical decisions, and help develop the next generation of engineering leaders. This role combines deep technical expertise with organizational leadership, enabling you to drive modernization, improve platform resiliency, and deliver meaningful business outcomes at scale.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader Aladdin strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps, leading modernization initiatives and balancing technical debt reduction with delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 12 years of demonstrated leadership experience across enterprise-scale software engineering environments.
* Deep expertise in modern application architecture, distributed systems, microservices, application programming interfaces (APIs), event-driven architectures, and enterprise software design.
* Strong technical depth across enterprise application development and data architecture, including large-scale processing, data modeling, performance optimization, and software engineering best practices.
* Experience designing and operating large-scale application and data platforms using modern messaging, caching, and distributed processing approaches.
* Demonstrated success defining technology strategy, leading complex multi-team initiatives, and balancing modernization investments with delivery objectives.
* Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, risk management, reliability, security, and operational excellence capabilities within business-critical environments.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM) concepts, cloud-native platforms, observability technologies, automation frameworks, and regulated financial-services environments.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Engineering Manager - Data & Platform
description:
**Who We Are**
At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.
  
  
As Bluehost scales, reliability and good data both depend on strong platform engineering. You'll lead the team that keeps our infrastructure resilient and our data trustworthy — from cloud architecture and containerized hosting to backup/disaster recovery, observability, and the pipelines that turn raw data into insight for product and growth teams across a fast-growing SMB SaaS platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark**
This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a small team while staying hands-on as a software engineer yourself.
  
  
As a manager
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of ~4 engineers spanning data engineering, devops, cloud infrastructure, hosting solutions, and observability — hiring, mentoring, and owning performance and career development.
* Set technical direction and priorities across the team's full portfolio: data pipelines, public cloud configuration, containerized hosting, backup/disaster recovery, observability, and internal automation.
* Partner directly with product, analytics, security, and engineering leadership to translate ambiguous business needs into infrastructure and data roadmaps.
* Drive on-call and incident-response practices so pipeline, cloud, and hosting issues are caught before they hit customers or a dashboard.
* Report on team health, system reliability, and roadmap progress to leadership.

As an engineer
  
  

* Personally design, build, and maintain production systems across the team's domains — pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containerized services, and automation — not just review others' work.
* Write and review code for data pipelines, devops tooling, cloud configuration (infrastructure-as-code), observability instrumentation, and backup/recovery solutions.
* Own or co-own the most complex or cross-cutting technical problems — architecture decisions, major incidents, and backup/DR strategy and testing.
* Use AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up your own development and debugging, and help the team adopt them effectively.
* Write tested, version-controlled code and contribute to CI/CD practices that catch regressions — data-quality, infrastructure, or otherwise — before they ship.
* Document architecture, data models, lineage, and operational runbooks so other teams can self-serve with confidence.

**Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed**

* 4-6 years of hands-on engineering experience across data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, or devops, including some experience leading projects, mentoring engineers, or formally managing a team.
* Real experience building and operating production systems — not just one-off scripts — across at least two of: data pipelines, devops, cloud infrastructure, containerized hosting, observability, or backup/DR.
* Solid experience with relational databases and dimensional data-warehousing concepts, and strong SQL skills.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Oracle Cloud) — configuration, cost management, and security fundamentals.
* Experience with containerized hosting (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar).
* Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or similar) and backup/disaster-recovery practices.
* Working proficiency in Python (preferred) or another language commonly used for data or platform engineering.
* Comfortable using AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up development, debugging, and validation.
* Strong communicator, able to translate ambiguous business needs into technical plans for both your team and stakeholders.

Bonus
  
  

* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or ClickHouse), orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect), or event-streaming tools (Kafka).
* Prior experience formally managing an engineering team.

**Why You'll Love Us**

* We’ve evolved. we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

#Bluehost
  
  
**This Job Description includes the essential job functions required to perform the job described above, as well as additional duties and responsibilities. This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master’s or similar degree in computer science, engineering, business information technologies or related fields.

* Proficiency in utilized development environments like ABAP Development Tools (ADT) in Eclipse.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to SAP BTP and cloud integrations.
* Should be flexible and adaptable to new technologies
* Knowledge on SAP Cloud Platform, SAP API, Python, Google Cloud Platform
* Leverage AI-driven development capabilities including Joule for Developers

 The Technical Lead C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra\-low\-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands\-on, high\-performance C\+\+ systems programming (roughly 60%\-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30–40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high\-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond\-optimized code implementation.
 



 Core Role Information
 


* Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) – C\+\+ Development
* Department: Technology
* Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Development Head



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Hands\-on Low\-Latency Systems Engineering** 



* Write, optimize, and maintain high\-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\).
* Implement deterministic, low\-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot\-path through custom memory pools and placement new.
* Develop ultra\-fast Inter\-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks—such as shared memory rings and lock\-free circular queues—to pass data across trading components with sub\-microsecond overhead.
* Design highly concurrent, multi\-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread\_setaffinity\_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention.
* Incorporate proprietary template\-based architectures or High\-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile\-time.



**2\. Core Data Engineering \& Domain Integration** 



* Apply expert\-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions.
* Design and maintain high\-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management.
* Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Code Governance** 



* Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery.
* Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking.
* Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team.



  





**Job Specific Skills** 



* C\+\+ \& Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems\-level C\+\+, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety.
* Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production\-grade, lock\-free, atomic, and multi\-threaded processing pipelines.
* Low\-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass).
* Data Layout \& DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL.
* HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero\-overhead abstractions.



  





**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream.
* Experience: 8\+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3\+ years of experience leading small\-to\-mid\-sized developer teams or pods.
* Domain Advantage: Prior background in High\-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable.



  





 For more details, contact Archana at Archana.tiwari@tnmhr.com / \+91 9821821884\.

You will role partner closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Architecture, and Risk/Controls to deliver scalable capabilities and outcomes the field can use immediately. * Run governance forums and issue and remediation processes aligned to delivery priorities. Enables sales and business teams with timely, trusted insights that drive targeting, retention, and portfolio actions.
* Leads multi\-disciplinary teams (analytics, data science, product, engineering, governance) including hiring, coaching, and performance management. Manages budget and capacity planning, partner engagement as needed, and ROI and value tracking tied to outcomes.
* Sets direction and governance for agentic AI\-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI\-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernization, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale

* Track record delivering enterprise analytics and AI solutions end\-to\-end, from intake and roadmap to production, adoption, and ongoing operations.
* Demonstrated engineering leadership with strong SDLC discipline (code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, release governance).
* Ownership of non\-functional requirements for business\-critical platforms (availability, resiliency, performance, observability, security).
* Strong understanding of modern data platforms and governance (data products, metadata and lineage, data quality, access controls).

* Executive stakeholder management across Technology, Product, Sales, Operations, and Risk/Controls, with the ability to translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading adoption of agentic AI\-enabled engineering practices (using enterprise\-authorized tools within the work environment) across teams, including defining operating expectations (human\-in\-the\-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, resiliency/security implications, and governance; ability to influence leaders on safe scaling patterns and reuse.

* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.

title: Member of Applied AI -Architect { Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as
 **a hands\-on senior technical architect** 
 on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end\-to\-end design and delivery of AI\-driven business transformation projects.
   

  

 You'll work closely with pre\-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
   

  

 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
   

  

 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Customer\-facing: 80% working directly with customers
* Design \& Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype \& Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof\-of\-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long\-term scalability.


**What You Bring**
* Experience: 7\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud \& DevOps: Hands\-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data\-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.


 As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
   

  

*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law.  Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.

* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
