description:
**About Company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Experience** 



* 7\+ years of overall experience in data management, MDM, data architecture
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Master Data Management experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with Profisee MDM is mandatory
* Prior experience reviewing, troubleshooting, stabilising or optimizing an existing Profisee implementation is highly desirable



  





**Required Technical Experience** 




**Mandatory:** 



* Hands\-on Profisee implementation experience
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Profisee
* Strong understanding of Profisee architecture and implementation patterns
* Experience with Profisee data models, matching, merging, survivorship and workflows
* Experience analysing Profisee integrations and downstream data flows
* Strong understanding of MDM data quality and governance
* Experience working with complex enterprise integration landscapes



**Desirable:** 



* Azure / Microsoft Fabric / Microsoft Purview experience
* Experience with APIs and integration platforms
* Experience with ERP/CRM environments such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle or similar
* Experience with data stewardship and operating\-model design
* Experience conducting MDM health checks, architecture reviews or implementation assessments



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 The successful candidate will:
 



**1\. Current\-State Assessment** 



* Review the existing Profisee implementation, architecture and configuration
* Understand the current MDM operating model, business processes and ownership
* Document key challenges, impacted business processes and manual workarounds
* Review how master data is created, changed, approved, mastered and distributed
* Assess the current roles and responsibilities across business, data stewardship, technology and support teams



**2\. Profisee Implementation Review** 



* Assess whether the Profisee implementation is appropriately designed for the organisation's business requirements
* Identify areas of unnecessary complexity, over\-engineering or configuration that may be contributing to operational issues
* Review Profisee data models, entities, attributes, relationships and hierarchies
* Review matching, merging and survivorship configuration
* Review workflows, stewardship processes, validation rules and business rules
* Assess whether configuration follows Profisee implementation best practices
* Identify configuration/design issues that may impact data quality or downstream processing



**3\. Integration \& Data Flow Review** 



* Review the end\-to\-end integration architecture surrounding Profisee
* Trace critical data flows from source systems through Profisee to downstream applications
* Investigate issues associated with incorrect or unexpected data updates reaching downstream systems
* Assess interfaces, APIs, integration services, event/batch mechanisms and transformation logic
* Identify potential issues around data ownership, change propagation, sequencing, dependencies and error handling
* Assess monitoring, reconciliation, exception handling and support processes
* Recommend improvements to integration patterns and controls



**4\. Data Migration \& Data Quality Assessment** 



* Assess the approach used to migrate data into Profisee
* Evaluate the organisation's confidence in migrated master data
* Identify gaps in reconciliation, validation and data\-quality controls
* Review DQ rules, thresholds and validation logic
* Assess whether current DQ controls are overly restrictive or generating unnecessary operational effort
* Recommend a pragmatic approach to balancing data quality, business usability and operational efficiency

* Drive adoption of new platforms across customer deals, increasing the share of platform\-led solutions vs bespoke hardware\-only solutions.

 AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto\-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.
 



  





 CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognized for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022\. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.
 



  





 AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading \& liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back\-office, product management, technology \& engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.
 



  





**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)** 




  





 At AMINA India, we are looking for an experienced professional to lead end‑to‑end process discovery, redesign, and AI\-driven automation across critical business functions, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and measurable impact. The role also champions compliant, well\-governed solutions while driving adoption through close collaboration with stakeholders, delivering sustainable, high\-value transformation.
 



  





**Your AMINA To\-Do List** 




  





**Discover, map and redesign processes** 



* Run process\-discovery workshops with teams across compliance, onboarding, operations, treasury, and client services.
* Produce clear, accurate process maps (BPMN or equivalent) and document the inputs, decisions, controls, and hand\-offs in each workflow.
* Redesign and optimize the process at hand, preparing it for potential automation / AI integration
* Identify automation candidates and quantify the opportunity — FTE saved, cycle\-time reduction, error\-rate impact, and cost.



**Design and build AI\-driven automation** 



* Translate process pain points into automation solutions using LLM\-based workflows, integration platforms, and APIs.
* Build, test, and iterate on automations — from document extraction and drafting assistants to alert triage, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Engineer reliable prompts and pipelines, design the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and evaluate AI output quality with real test sets rather than vibes.
* Track token usage, run\-cost, and ROI per initiative, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and model\-selection decisions.



**Keep it compliant and governed** 



* Design every automation so the accountable human still owns the decision — especially in regulated processes (KYC/AML, transaction monitoring, reporting).
* Work with Compliance, Risk, and IT to ensure solutions meet control, audit, data\-protection, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation, change logs, and a clear inventory of what's automated, who owns it, and how it's monitored.



**Drive adoption** 



* Partner with business owners to pilot, refine, and roll out automations — and to get genuine buy\-in, not shelfware.
* Build internal momentum for AI adoption in a risk\-aware environment, navigating IT and security gatekeeping constructively.
* Train users, write SOPs, and hand over solutions in a maintainable state.



  





**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:** 




  




* 4–10 years of experience in Business Process Management, Process Improvement, Automation, or Operational Transformation.
* Proven experience analyzing, redesigning, and optimizing business processes using structured methodologies (e.g., BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma, Process Mining).
* Strong stakeholder management and requirements\-gathering skills across business and technical teams.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and workflow automation tools, including LLMs, APIs, and integration platforms (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier).
* Practical understanding of prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and implementation of appropriate controls and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages and data analysis.
* Experience within banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* Understanding of financial\-services processes such as KYC, AML, onboarding, payments, reconciliation, or regulatory reporting.
* Knowledge of risk, controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance considerations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge business, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
* Self\-starter with a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach and the ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.



 Preferred
 


* Experience with crypto, digital assets, or blockchain\-related processes.
* Familiarity with FINMA, MiCA, AML, or similar regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with RAG, AI assistants, agentic workflows, Process Mining, or RPA tools. German language skills are a plus.



  





**Why We’re Awesome** 




  





 We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank.
 **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!** 




  





 Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (Solution Architect)
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose**
 Worley is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to define and deliver integrated digital, OT, IT, data, application, infrastructure, integration, and security architectures for major industrial programs. The role will translate business and operational objectives into practical solution designs, architecture artefacts, integration models, and implementation\-ready guidance supporting procurement, vendor assessment, FEED delivery, and project execution. The ideal candidate will bring strong architecture capability, practical IT/OT integration experience, cybersecurity\-by\-design awareness, and the ability to align client, engineering, vendor, and delivery stakeholders around secure, scalable, and operationally maintainable outcomes.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Develop solution architectures across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, OT, IT, and security domains, ensuring alignment with client reference models and delivery\-phase requirements.
* Translate enterprise architecture, business objectives, and operational requirements into actionable solution designs that guide procurement, vendor assessment, implementation planning, and project execution.
* Produce implementation\-focused architecture artefacts, including system context diagrams, logical and physical architecture views, integration models, infrastructure deployment views, network segmentation concepts, platform deployment views, application interface definitions, and architecture decision records.
* Define integration and interoperability models across industrial levels 1\-4, including OT/IT convergence, edge/cloud hybrid deployments, data exchange patterns, secure connectivity, and segmented network architectures.
* Apply architecture governance to ensure solutions meet client standards, engineering requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable industrial frameworks such as IEC 62443, ISA\-95, OPC UA, MQTT, and other relevant integration patterns.
* Collaborate with internal and client\-side stakeholders, including OT, IT, cybersecurity, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, project delivery, vendors, and system integrators, to gather requirements, validate assumptions, and coordinate architecture inputs.
* Support traceability of business, operational, functional, non\-functional, and technical requirements through architecture artefacts and requirements management tools.
* Assess vendor and system integrator solutions for functional alignment, technical feasibility, interoperability, cybersecurity, maintainability, scalability, and lifecycle suitability.
* Contribute to risk assessments, cost\-benefit analysis, project option selection, transition planning, and FEED\-to\-delivery handover.
* Support design reviews, workshops, procurement packages, tender responses, implementation planning, and executive\-level technical briefings.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to multidisciplinary teams while maintaining alignment with project governance, quality, safety, and delivery assurance processes.
* Identify architecture risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions, and support their resolution through structured engagement with stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of emerging industrial digital, OT networking, cybersecurity, cloud, edge, data, and automation technologies and apply them pragmatically where they provide measurable client value.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Deep experience in solution architecture across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains.
* Strong understanding of OT and IT networking technologies, including segmented networks, SDN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, hosting services, cloud networks, secure remote access, and IT/OT convergence strategies.
* Knowledge of industrial automation and control systems architectures, including fixed and wireless networks, telemetry, SCADA, PLCs, DCS, historians, edge systems, and the transport of critical production data.
* Experience developing high\-fidelity architecture artefacts that support system procurement, design validation, implementation planning, and stakeholder decision\-making.
* Practical understanding of IT/OT system interoperability in mining, resources, utilities, oil and gas, or other large\-scale industrial programs.
* Knowledge of integration patterns and protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, API gateways, message brokers, industrial data platforms, and secure data exchange across OT and enterprise environments.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity\-by\-design principles, including network segmentation, Zero Trust concepts, defence\-in\-depth, access control, secure interfaces, and industrial cybersecurity standards.
* Ability to align diverse technical stakeholders through structured architecture methods, workshops, design reviews, decision records, and clear visual communication.
* Experience in hybrid cloud\-edge deployments, remote operations concepts, platform orchestration, digital integration, and secure connectivity for operational environments.
* Ability to support cost, risk, schedule, procurement, vendor, and delivery decisions with architecture\-led evidence and traceability.


**Other Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Control Systems, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\-15 years of relevant experience in solution architecture, systems architecture, digital architecture, OT/IT architecture, or industrial technology architecture within mining, resources, energy, utilities, oil and gas, or large\-scale industrial environments.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business, operational, and engineering requirements into practical, implementable architecture solutions.
* Experience producing architecture artefacts, architecture decisions, technical assessments, solution options, system interface definitions, and implementation\-supporting documentation.
* Experience collaborating with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, OT, IT, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, vendor, and project delivery teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architecture concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of project delivery lifecycles from concept and FEED through detailed design, implementation support, commissioning, and handover.
* Architecture certifications such as TOGAF, SABSA, ArchiMate, Azure/AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent practical credentials.
* Network, cybersecurity, or OT credentials such as CCNP, IEC 62443 Foundation/Practitioner, CISSP, GICSP, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with architecture modelling, requirements traceability, and portfolio tools such as Orbus Infinity, ArchiMate\-based tooling, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial digital platforms, data platforms, edge computing, cloud integration, remote operations, autonomous systems, and critical communications environments.
* Experience supporting procurement, vendor assessment, RFP/RFQ development, technical bid evaluation, and implementation transition planning.
* Structured, pragmatic, and outcome\-focused, with the ability to navigate technical ambiguity and convert complex requirements into clear architecture direction.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in complex, multidisciplinary delivery environments.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, executives, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, security\-related, and commercially confidential information.
* Proactive, service\-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve client and project outcomes.
* Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, sustainability, and Worley values.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise\-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands\-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre\-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI\-native approaches into every engagement.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre\-sales leadership, and practice development.
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts


 \#\# Required Qualifications
   

  

 \#\#\# Technical Expertise
   

  

* \*\*10\+ years\*\* of hands\-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3\+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM\-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi\-region, multi\-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000\+ concurrent contacts


 \#\#\# Consulting \& Leadership
   

  

* \*\*Pre\-sales experience\*\* — led or co\-led 5\+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end\-to\-end delivery on engagements with 5\+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go\-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C\-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3\+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions


 \#\#\# Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
   

  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step\-by\-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands\-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi\-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real\-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Working Model
   

  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands\-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre\-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# About the Team
   

  

 AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI\-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
   

  

 We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
   

  

 \* \* \*
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Delivery (80%)


 Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi\-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real\-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M\+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go\-live
* Build production\-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third\-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI\-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex\-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real\-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre\-Sales Leadership (10%)
* Lead customer discovery conduct workshops, ideation sessions, and technical deep\-dives to understand customer pain points and define CX transformation roadmaps
* Create compelling proposals develop SOWs, technical architectures, effort estimations, and delivery plans for complex Connect engagements
* Present to C\-suite and senior stakeholders articulate business value, ROI projections, and differentiated solution approaches during competitive evaluations
* Support pipeline development collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and Engagement Managers to identify and qualify opportunities worth $500K–$5M\+
* Shape deal strategy define technical win themes, competitive positioning, and phased delivery approaches that de\-risk customer commitments
* Practice \& Team Leadership (10%)
* Lead and mentor a team of Connect consultants, providing architectural guidance, code reviews, and career development coaching
* Drive capability uplift work with AWS Connect Specialist SAs and Product teams to enable the team on new features (Q in Connect, multi\-party calls, outbound campaigns, generative AI integrations)
* Establish technical governance define coding standards, deployment patterns, testing frameworks, and architectural review processes for the Connect practice

* Build partnerships collaborate with Connect product teams on feature requests, roadmap influence, and early\-access programs; provide field feedback to shape product direction

 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

 Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information.  www.seclore.com
 
 .

 We are seeking a customer\-focused Technical Consultant to provide end\-to\-end technical consulting, solution design, deployment, upgrades, migrations, troubleshooting, performance analysis, training, and documentation for Seclore solutions. The role requires hands\-on expertise across Windows/Linux infrastructure, web and application servers, databases, networking, security, Docker, and cloud technologies — plus the ability to translate complex customer requirements into practical solutions and use AI tools responsibly to boost technical productivity.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Consulting \& Solution Design** 



* Run technical discovery workshops and analyze customer environments to design deployment and integration architectures.
* Prepare HLD/LLD, sizing, and configuration documentation, and act as technical advisor through the implementation lifecycle.



  





**Deployment, Upgrades \& Migrations** 



* Lead end\-to\-end installation, configuration, integration, and production\-readiness of Seclore solutions.
* Plan and execute upgrades, migrations, redeployments, and platform transformations with minimal customer disruption.



  





**Troubleshooting \& Performance** 



* Diagnose complex issues via log, system, and network analysis; drive structured root\-cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Perform health checks, performance benchmarking, infrastructure sizing, and capacity planning with actionable recommendations.



  





**Enterprise Security \& Cloud** 



* Work with AD/LDAP, SSL/TLS, DNS, firewalls, load balancers, and enterprise authentication systems to secure deployments.
* Support on\-prem, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and Docker/containerized deployments, including container networking and lifecycle management.



  





**Automation, AI \& Documentation** 



* Automate deployment, monitoring, and operational tasks using PowerShell/Shell (Python a plus); build reusable tooling.
* Use approved GenAI/LLM tools responsibly for research, troubleshooting, and documentation, validating outputs before use.
* Maintain high\-quality technical documentation — HLD/LLD, deployment guides, migration plans, and health\-check reports.



  





**Customer \& Project Management** 



* Act as trusted technical advisor and primary point of contact, managing expectations across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Sales, Presales, Support, Product, Engineering, and Cloud/DevOps teams to deliver projects on time and to quality.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong background in enterprise software deployment, implementation, and troubleshooting, with solid infrastructure and architecture knowledge.
* Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu), Apache/Tomcat, SSL/TLS, and core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewall, proxy, load balancer).

* Practical awareness of GenAI/LLM tools and responsible AI usage, including data privacy and output validation.

 We're looking for a customer\-focused technologist with a “learn, solve, automate, and improve” mindset — comfortable in complex enterprise environments and ready to grow with Seclore's technology landscape across cloud, containers, automation, security, and AI.

title: Architect — Design Management
description:
Architect — Design Management \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  





 A developer's design manager is not a practice's project architect. Own the drawing from the yield test at land stage to the set issued to site, for a platform breaking ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January — and make sure the masterplan that wins the deal is the one that gets built.
 



  





 A note before you read on. Team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the platform's current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  





 REPORTS TO: Head of Projects, or the CEO — Development Business until that seat is filled · DIRECT REPORTS: none; the consultant teams on every project are commanded by this seat · ASSET CLASSES: Grade A warehouses, logistics parks and industrial parks, PEB and RCC
 



  






 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth. Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  






 THE PROJECTS TEAM
 




 Vantrock designs and builds in\-house. The projects function owns the asset from the first block plan to the day an occupier takes possession, and design management owns the drawing across all of it. The function is being built now, the seat does not exist in this form anywhere in the market, and the person who joins it will decide what it becomes.
 



  






 DESIGN OWNERSHIP, NOT COORDINATION
 




 In a practice, the drawing is the product. Here it is a means, and the product is a park that leases, clears its approvals and gets built for the number it was underwritten at.
 



 Land is our largest single cost and the masterplan is where it is either monetised or wasted. A point of ground coverage, a badly oriented dock face, a late fire NOC — each costs more than the entire design fee. This seat finds the yield, proves it is compliant, and makes sure it survives contact with site.
 



  






 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 




 The platform breaks ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January and has 10 million behind it, across four cities and more than one state's development\-control regime. Every masterplan drawn this year will be built and leased for the next ten, approvals sit on the critical path in every state, and nobody owns them end to end today. This is the first design seat, and it sets the standards the portfolio is built to.
 



  






 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 




 1\. The yield test at land stage — ground coverage, FSI, setbacks, truck circulation, dock\-face orientation and phasing on every opportunity, and the block plan and area statement the land recommendation is made on.
 



 2\. The portfolio design standards — 17 m bay grid, 12\.5 m clear height, 1:7,500 sq ft dock ratio, 28\.5 m yard depth, office area, FM2 and TR34 floors, defended against anything that erodes usable area.
 



 3\. The approval path — state industrial authority, town planning, fire NOC, environmental clearance, factory and DISH, CTE and CTO, on a live tracker with a real critical path.
 



 4\. The GFC set — coordinated, construction\-ready, issued in a state where the site does not have to ask what was meant. Site RFIs are the measure, and are counted.
 



 5\. The consultants — architectural, structural, MEP, façade and landscape, appointed, driven and held to what they hand over.
 



 6\. Buildability and change control — clash resolution before issue, then the RFI and design\-change log, with cost and time attached before a change reaches site.
 



 7\. Customer fit and design\-to\-cost — occupier briefs turned into fast, priced design responses, and design worked to the estimator's budget, not around it.
 



  






 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 





 ESSENTIAL
 




 – 10–15 years in design management, most of it on industrial, warehousing or logistics assets, at a developer, or at a practice or PMC on that portfolio at project\-lead level.
 



 – Parks you have masterplanned yourself, with the numbers: site area, BUA, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Tested in a practical.
 



 – The full statutory approval path run end to end in at least one state, and a working knowledge of how a second differs. NBC 2016, state fire and DCR in daily use.
 



 – Green certification to IGBC or LEED Platinum standard designed in from concept, not retrofitted at approval stage.
 



 – AutoCAD at expert level; fluent reading of structural and MEP drawings, specifications and contract conditions; SketchUp and Adobe for options, massing and presentation output.
 



 – Warehouse and industrial building systems: PEB and RCC, FM2 and TR34 flooring, dock equipment, K115 and K160 sprinklers, OSID and FAPA fire detection, roofing, cladding, external infrastructure.
 



 – Design\-to\-cost as a habit, not a phase: quantified options, value engineering without losing the specification.
 



 – B.Arch, with Council of Architecture registration. Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 




 ADVANTAGEOUS
 




 – M.Arch, NICMAR or an equivalent construction\-management qualification. IGBC AP or LEED AP.
 



 – Revit and BIM for model\-based coordination rather than drawings with a model on the side. Power BI for approval trackers, drawing registers and design\-change dashboards.
 



 – Temperature\-controlled, cross\-dock or automation\-ready fit\-outs. Approvals in more than one state.
 




 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 




 – Not a practice seat: the drawing is not the deliverable, a park that leases and gets built is. Not consultant coordination: you appoint, direct and hold the consultants. Not a delivery seat: execution on site belongs to projects. Not the programme office: cost and schedule control across the portfolio sits there.
 



  






 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 – Developer side, with real decision rights. You can reject a consultant's set, hold a land recommendation, and refuse a change that has not been priced.
 



 – Every decision traceable. A yield option has an area statement behind it; a released drawing has a name against it.
 



 – The reporting is not your job. Trackers, registers, RFI logs and dashboards run on Vantrock Intelligence, built before we bought an acre.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, travel to every site.
 



 JUDGED ON FOUR STANDARDS, TOGETHER. Yield: BUA per acre, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Compliance: approvals on the critical path, NBC and fire, green certification. Buildability: coordinated GFC sets, minimal site RFIs. Customer fit: BTS response and occupier specification.
 



  






 COMPENSATION
 




 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely. Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives, confirmed in the offer.
 



  






 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat: fluent use of AI tools for option generation, code and drawing checking, research and presentation output, and building on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test runs at every level, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second. The design is ours, but consultants, PMCs and liaison agents are commanded by this seat — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to.
 



  






 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days, with two links: six questions answered by AI interview, about forty minutes, reviewed before the CV, and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there: a design conversation on a park you masterplanned, walked through in numbers; a three\-hour supervised practical on a real parcel with a real access constraint, a development\-control extract and an occupier brief, from which you produce an area statement, a block plan, two yield options with the trade\-off stated, and the approvals on the critical path; then two references, contacted directly.
 



 Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  






 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Architect — Design Management — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. Mandatory: a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application, though we read that too.
 



 – Your Yield Sheet — one row per park you masterplanned: state, site area, BUA, ground coverage, clear height, dock ratio, asset type, your role, and whether it was built. Template on request.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the design decision you have seen destroy the most yield on an industrial park, and the check you would build so it never survives to GFC. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read all that arrives that arrives with a Yield Sheet and a paragraph, properly, not skimmed.
 



  





 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 



 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock
